description: Read-only access to local pack rank check configs and their latest check. With `configId`, returns that config's latest check: `status` is "found" (a real 1-based `position` within Google's local pack), "not_found" (the page parsed cleanly but the business was not among the entries seen), or "unavailable" (the scraper is disabled, blocked, or nothing could be parsed) — never a fabricated position or confidence score. Without `configId`, lists all local pack rank configs in the project. This checks Google's LOCAL PACK for a named BUSINESS, distinct from get_local_rank_grid, which checks ORGANIC rank for a DOMAIN across a geo-grid. Create a config with create_local_pack_rank_config and run a new check with run_local_pack_rank_check.

configId.description: Local pack rank config ID. If omitted, lists all configs in the project.

projectId.description: Required. The MisarSEO project ID to scope this call to. Get one from list_projects.

name: get_local_pack_rank
